# Phase 2 worked examples - generated by `prototype/rules_v2.py`

Every number below is produced by the engine at run time; nothing is typed in by hand.
Each case is submitted as a JSON document that validates against `schema/input.schema.json`, so these examples double as contract tests.
D-01: the figures shown are the underlying decimals. No business rounding is applied; a total written as a range means the underlying model is genuinely unresolved.
